title: BNCI 2015-010 RSVP P300 dataset
description: A Brain Computer Interface dataset implementing rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) for gaze-independent P300-based spelling. This derivative dataset comprises preprocessed EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing a mental typewriting task with three experimental conditions varying stimulus onset asynchrony and color cues. The data is derived from the original study by Acqualagna & Blankertz (2013), with preprocessing including artifact rejection, filtering, and baseline correction, and classification achieved using linear discriminant analysis on spatio-temporal features.
methods_description: EEG data acquired at 1000 Hz using 63 active electrodes in 10-20 montage with BrainAmp amplifiers and actiCap system, referenced to left mastoid. Online lowpass Chebyshev filtering at 40 Hz applied during acquisition. Offline preprocessing included re-referencing to linked mastoids, downsampling to 200 Hz, artifact rejection using min-max criterion for eye movements and broadband power rejection, and baseline correction. Classification employed LDA with shrinkage on spatio-temporal features from individually selected time windows across 10 symbol sequences.
